notes: Teleprompter. Bookmark shortcuts: press 1 to 9 to jump straight to a section, from the control panel or the output window, with the number printed on the button - and the Control API page now lists a ready-made Stream Deck key for every section in the script, addressed by name so rewriting the script does not re-point your keys. Where you are - the position bar, the timings and the section buttons - has moved above the transport, because when you drive from shortcuts that is what you need in your eyeline. Open a document: Word (.docx), rich text (.rtf) and plain text, from a button or by dragging the file onto the script box, and headings in the document come across as bookmarks on their own. Put it on a monitor: on the computer running the app, pick a display and send the normal or mirrored output straight to it, full screen.
